title: Ginat Egoz (Hebrew, 1615 imprint)
author: Joseph Gikatilla
description: Joseph Gikatilla's early Kabbalistic work in a historical Hebrew imprint. The title's garden of the nut introduces an exploration of sacred language, letters and number within Jewish mystical interpretation.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/ginategoz00gika).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
